quirks.summary: Portal URL and vendor come from PlanIt's directory; neither the vendor nor any retrieval step has been verified against this portal.
quirks.detail: PlanIt reports scraper_type 'Custom'. That label is a hint, not a finding - it is recorded elsewhere in this skill as stale at one authority and wrong at another. Fingerprint the portal before choosing a recipe, and set portal.vendor_verified when you have.
quirks.workaround: Run the vendor detection signatures in vendors.json against the portal before applying any recipe.

quirks.summary: Recorded vendor was 'custom-other'; the portal fingerprints as 'def-atrium'.
quirks.detail: The previous value came from PlanIt's scraper_type, which is a directory label rather than a finding. The fingerprint is taken from the portal's own markup.
quirks.workaround: Apply the def-atrium recipe, not the custom-other one.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

quirks.summary: The Atrium application is not mounted at the site root; /Search/Results and the anti-forgery token are under a path prefix.
quirks.detail: Recipe A's endpoints are written root-relative and they 404, or the search page carries no __RequestVerificationToken. Sampled 2026-09-16. The mount path is a per-install fact and is not yet recorded here.
quirks.workaround: Open the register in a browser, note the path the search form posts to, and record it in endpoints.search.
